subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-10-19
html:
Rank stayed flat for a 19th straight week (0 of 22 tracked keywords, avg position 100; backlinks flat 3/2 referring domains since 09-10). CI stayed green: 53/53 SEO Report Email runs all-time. catalog.ts/destinations/catalog.ts are both unchanged — shareable_dashboard's "October 2026" ETA still hasn't flipped with under 2 weeks left in the month. The FOCUS MCP-integration keyword cluster (5/5 connector pages, 5/5 named comparisons, 10 blog posts) remains fully exhausted against current demand for a 4th straight session.

With no new keyword-driven page to build, this session picked up the prior session's own pointer to spot-check the static audits' remaining low-risk recommendations. Found one genuinely open, mechanical, code-actionable item in audits/geo-ai.md.

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
Homepage pricing section (src/components/Pricing.tsx)The pricing tiers (Free/Solo/Studio/Agency/Scale/Enterprise — price, description, full feature list) only existed as styled card <div>s, with no tabular structure for search/AI crawlers to parse directly. Added a visually-hidden, screen-reader-accessible <table> rendering the exact same data right after the cards, so answer engines and Google's table-extraction can read plan → price → what's-included as real structured markup. The visual cards are unchanged; this is a second, identical-content representation, not new copy.No single keyword — GEO/AI-citation structural fix (ARLO pricing extractability)askarlo.app/#pricing — view page source and search for <table> under the pricing section to confirm the semantic markup shipped alongside the visible cards.

Next: keep re-pulling the FOCUS keyword cluster fresh each session and watch for any gated connector or the shareable_dashboard destination flipping off coming_soon. The remaining open, code-actionable audit item (rewriting H2/H3 headings into question form, site-wide) was judged too broad for an unattended pass and is flagged for a future session to scope down. Everything else now needs a human decision: GSC submission, off-page outreach, AI Result Tracker setup, a real CSP, the www redirect, IndexNow, a second case study, and whether to wire in or delete the dead generateSchema() helper.
